trajectory.patch:
The segmentation fault occurs due to heap corruption. In the `test_malloc` test case, the dynamically allocated memory is freed twice.

```c
k_free(actual_message_data->reference); k_free(actual_message_data->reference);
```

This double free corrupts the heap metadata. When the test suite is run, and `test_malloc` is executed, the `k_malloc` at the beginning of the test may receive a pointer to a corrupted or invalid memory region due to the heap state being compromised by a previous run (potentially by the test runner re-running tests). When the listener callback `s1_cb` attempts to access this memory via `memcpy`, it results in a segmentation fault.

The fix is to remove the redundant `k_free` call to prevent heap corruption.

tests/subsys/zbus/dyn_channel/src/main.c
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
	k_free(actual_message_data->reference); k_free(actual_message_data->reference);
========
	k_free(actual_message_data->reference);
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
